newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Three workers die in Singapore shipyard.
newsitem.headline: Three workers die in Singapore shipyard.

text.p: Three workers died in a Singapore shipyard accident, apparently suffocating inside the fuel tank of an oil rig, the government said on Tuesday.
It said in a statement that one man collapsed as he was going down into the fuel tank to check why a pump placed there to empty it of sea water was not working.
Two rescue workers who went into the tank to pull the man out also collapsed and died.
"It is suspected that the workers collapsed due to the deficiency of oxygen inside the tank," the Ministry of Labour statement said.
